indicators.label: Real gross domestic product
comparison_guardrails: Aggregate output does not establish per-person or household improvement.
Reconcile annualized quarterly rates with year-over-year and level measures.

indicators.label: Real GDP per capita
comparison_guardrails: Reconcile population estimates and price bases.
Do not equate output per person with median household income.

indicators.label: Real median household income
indicators.concept: Inflation-adjusted income at the household median
comparison_guardrails: Reconcile household definition, taxes, transfers, and equivalence scales.

indicators.label: Household wealth distribution
indicators.concept: Share or level of wealth held by population groups
comparison_guardrails: Aggregate wealth cannot represent the median household.

indicators.label: Housing affordability
indicators.concept: Housing cost relative to income or purchasing capacity
comparison_guardrails: Reconcile owner, renter, mortgage, tax, insurance, and regional coverage.

indicators.label: Household debt burden
indicators.concept: Debt level or service burden relative to income or assets
comparison_guardrails: Reconcile mortgage terms, interest resets, consumer credit, and income denominator.

indicators.label: Trade concentration
indicators.concept: Share of exports or imports associated with a trading partner
comparison_guardrails: Separate goods, services, sectors, value added, and gross flows.

indicators.label: Tariff incidence
indicators.concept: Distribution of tariff cost among importers, producers, workers, consumers, and government
comparison_guardrails: Legal payer does not by itself establish final economic incidence.
Separate revenue transfer from efficiency loss.

indicators.label: Labor market security
indicators.concept: Employment quantity, quality, stability, wages, hours, and bargaining position
comparison_guardrails: Unemployment alone does not capture underemployment, displacement, job quality, or labor-force exit.

indicators.label: AI, automation, and robotics labor effect
indicators.concept: Observed task, hiring, employment, wage, or bargaining effects attributable to automation with bounded controls
comparison_guardrails: Technology adoption timing does not establish displacement causation.
Separate augmentation, substitution, reclassification, and demand effects.

guardrails: Every comparison reconciles definitions before values.
Missing evidence creates a search task, not a provisional conclusion.
